rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something organized according to a planned method.

example.english: We used a systematic method to organize the documents.
example.traditional: 我哋用有系統嘅方法整理啲文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 jau5 hai6 tung2 ge3 fong1 faat3 zing2 lei5 di1 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when something is done methodically in clear successive steps.

example.english: We work in a systematic, step-by-step way, so things do not get messy.
example.traditional: 我哋做嘢好有步驟，一步一步嚟，唔會亂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 bou6 zau6 jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 lei4 m4 wui5 lyun6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being orderly, coherent, and easy to follow rather than on a formal procedure.

example.english: They explain things in a systematic and easy-to-follow way, so everyone understands at once.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢好有條理，大家一聽就明。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 tiu4 lei5 daai6 gaa1 jat1 teng1 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use this formal term when research or analysis treats its subject as an interconnected system or whole.

example.english: This report uses a systematic approach to analyze the industry as a whole.
example.traditional: 呢份報告用系統性方法分析成個行業。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jung6 hai6 tung2 sing3 fong1 faat3 fan1 sik1 seng4 go3 hong4 jip6
